text:
jess: Heads up — seeing a bunch of 400s from the Python SDK after last night's platform deploy. Error mentions missing policy header. Anyone else?
rick: yep reproduced in my e2e run. failing request: `POST /v1/generate 400` with body fine but response: "missing X-Policy-Version"
rick: stack excerpt:
```
requests.exceptions.HTTPError: 400 Client Error: Bad Request for url: https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
response.json() => {"error":"missing X-Policy-Version"}
```
mika: that's from the new policy-gating feature flip — we added a required header for tenants opting into per-route policy. We intended to gate it behind a rollout flag but the compatibility shim didn't land. my bad.
alana: Oof. So legacy SDKs are now rejected. Can we add a backward-compat fallback in the client libs to send a default header value? We should avoid changing server to be permissive.
samir: I can add a quick patch to python today. Question: what default should we emit? Is it tenant-specific or global fallback? @mika
mika: Tenant-scoped normally, but for compatibility the server expects a header. We'll accept a default sentinel of `policy=legacy` for older clients. We'll add server-side note to map `policy=legacy` -> no-op policy.
ara-bot: FYI: feature-flag `policy_gating_v1` rolled out to prod at 2026-03-22T03:12Z (deploy id: rwd-plat-2026-0311).
alana: Sounds good. Plan: patch python and ts to include header by default for <x.y.z> versions, publish patch release, then coordinate a minor server tweak to tolerate missing header for 1h after patch rollout. Can we get a canary first?
rick: I'll do a canary on a single tenant (acct: beta-ops). I'll also add a small dashboard tile showing 4xx count by sdk-version so we can watch.
samir: Py patch idea (2-line):
```python
# in redwood/client.py send_request
headers.setdefault('X-Policy-Version', 'policy=legacy')
```
samir: will PR and cut 0.12.1 patch, add changelog note about compatibility.
jess: TS lib needs same. @alana can you pick up TS?
alana: Yep. For TS I'll default in the RequestBuilder: `headers['X-Policy-Version'] ??= 'policy=legacy'`. Will open PR after lunch.
mika: thanks. Also adding a quick server backfill to map missing->policy=legacy for the next hour during rollout. After we confirm client releases, we'll flip the flag fully and remove map.
rick: :eyes: I'll wire an alert to slack#incidents if 400s spike post-release.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: py/0.12.1-canary -> tenancy beta-ops (job 8821). ETA 10m.
jess: great. Post-PR checklist: add unit test asserting header present, add telemetry tag `compat:policy_v1` so console can show regression.
mika: going to add note to console rollout docs and the runbook.
samir: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/py-sdk/pull/421 (draft). Will add tests and cut canary once approved.
jess: awesome. Thanks team — aim to have fixes live in next 2 hours.
ara-bot: log: incident-tracking created (#INC-2026-042) due to increased 400s.
